summary: @servicetitan/titan-chatbot-client preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs` invoked from package.json) downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and immediately uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line obfuscated JavaScript blob (string-array indirection, rotating decoder function `WV8StW`, large numeric constant table `n7gIxM`) prefixed with a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header so ordinary Node cannot load it — only the fetched Bun interpreter executes it. `setup.mjs` also performs libc detection via `ldd --version` and `/etc/os-release` to select between six platform-specific Bun variants including a `linux-x64-musl-baseline` build for Alpine, ensuring the payload runs on Linux CI/container hosts as well as macOS/Windows developer machines. The advertised purpose is a React chatbot UI client; fetching a second language runtime at install time to execute an opaque, Node-invisible payload is not consistent with that purpose and matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern, where an alien interpreter is smuggled in specifically so the payload is invisible to Node-based supply-chain scanners. Arbitrary code execution occurs on every host that runs `npm install` of this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
